text: A year after Ronald DeFeo Jr. [shot his whole family|wrong|killing within the family] at 112 Ocean Avenue, newlyweds George and Kathy Lutz [move in with her three children|trigger|making a new home]. The priest who comes to bless the house is [swarmed by flies and told to get out|images|vermin and creeping things], and George, waking every night at 3:15, grows volatile and [obsessed with keeping the fire fed|threat|being taken over]. Behind the basement wall the dog keeps scratching, they find a small red room that a psychic calls [the passage to Hell|threat|the devil and dark gods].
